name: Purge natural human groups remain disabled
preconditions: Use a fresh isolated Purge save with a spawned player in loaded wilderness beyond any POI. Move the authority clock across a six-hour boundary on a non-blood-moon day. Match the location and slot against a separate positive-control run with the old policy enabled. On dedicated, pair these client samples with the host world-integration journal. This scenario does not cover retained group restoration or dog deployment.
